props.text: Persisted part runs — status and freshness update every second
FM497 Rev. 5 — calculation preview (not saved or sent to equipment)

config.script:
from java.lang import Exception as JavaException
	from washheat import domain
	try:
	    inputs = self.getSibling("Inputs")
	    result = domain.calculate_reheat(inputs.getChild("ODGroup").getChild("OD").props.text, inputs.getChild("HeightGroup").getChild("Height").props.text, inputs.getChild("CircleGroup").getChild("Circle").props.text, inputs.getChild("OutGroup").getChild("Out").props.text)
	    self.view.custom.calculation = system.util.jsonEncode(result, 2)
	except (Exception, JavaException) as error:
	    self.view.custom.calculation = "INVALID INPUT: " + str(error)

props.text: The seven FM497 fields are mapped. Target format/submission and Quality/Production acceptance are still pending.

config.script:
from java.lang import Exception as JavaException
	from washheat import service
	try:
	    record = system.util.jsonDecode(self.view.custom.recordPreview)
	    if record.get("record_schema") != "washheat.tropos-review.v1":
	        raise ValueError("Refresh and preview a completed record first.")
	    # Fetch the immutable persisted record by previewed ID, not the latest row.
	    payload = service.record_json(record["run_id"], record["episode_no"])
	    system.perspective.download("washheat-tropos-review-"+record["run_id"]+".json", payload, "application/json")
	except (Exception, JavaException) as error:
	    self.view.custom.message = "FAILED: " + str(error)

props.text: Ignition operator decisions — enter a run ID from the refreshed snapshot
Save calculated Cycle Start limit for this run

config.script:
from java.lang import Exception as JavaException
	from washheat import service
	try:
	    if not self.session.props.auth.authenticated:
	        raise ValueError("Sign in to save timing inputs.")
	    run_id = self.getSibling("DecisionRun").props.text
	    rows = [row for row in self.view.custom.runs if row["run_id"] == run_id]
	    if len(rows) != 1:
	        raise ValueError("Refresh and select one displayed run.")
	    inputs = {"max_transfer_seconds": self.getSibling("MaxTransfer").props.text,
	              "dh_cycle_start_seconds": self.getSibling("DHCycle").props.text,
	              "dh_tonnage_seconds": self.getSibling("DHTonnage").props.text}
	    state = service.record_transfer_limit(run_id, inputs, self.session.props.auth.user.userName, rows[0]["version"])
	    self.view.custom.calculation = system.util.jsonEncode(state["transfer_limit"], 2)
	    self.view.custom.runs = service.list_runs()
	except (Exception, JavaException) as error:
	    self.view.custom.message = "FAILED: " + str(error)

from java.lang import Exception as JavaException
	from washheat import service
	try:
	    if not self.session.props.auth.authenticated:
	        raise ValueError("Sign in to record an attributable operator decision.")
	    run_id = self.getSibling("DecisionRun").props.text
	    rows = [row for row in self.view.custom.runs if row["run_id"] == run_id]
	    if len(rows) != 1:
	        raise ValueError("Refresh and select a run from the displayed snapshot.")
	    service.record_decision(run_id, 'UNLOAD_OK', self.getSibling("DecisionReason").props.text, self.session.props.auth.user.userName, rows[0]["version"])
	    self.view.custom.runs = service.list_runs()
	    self.view.custom.message = "Operator decision saved in Ignition."
	except (Exception, JavaException) as error:
	    self.view.custom.message = "FAILED: " + str(error)
